note: [L] has the closure, coordinate-vector and evaluation argument with constant (1-a/p)⁻¹c, which is 2c at a = p/2, and uniqueness as `sole`. But `recovery` requires 1 ≤ a, so with a = R/2 it covers only R ≥ 2, while [M] assumes R > 1.

snippet.text:
lemma recovery [CompleteSpace E] (h:Rebar p f c) {a:ℝ} (ha:1≤a) (hp:a<p) : Scout a f ((1-a/p)⁻¹*c):=by
  have hr:=ha.trans_lt hp; have h':=zero_lt_one.trans hr; have hh:= zero_lt_one.trans_le ha
  obtain ⟨L,hL,ht⟩:= linear_snapshot h hr
  let X:=spans p; let Y:=(smear p).range
  have hK : Y≤X:=Y.le_topologicalClosure
  let q:Y→ₗ[ℝ] X:= Submodule.inclusion hK; have hu z: ‖q z‖≤1*‖z‖:= by rw [one_mul]; rfl
  let V:= q.mkContinuous 1 hu; have hV:DenseRange V:=by
    intro x; apply Metric.mem_closure_iff.2; intro ε he
    obtain ⟨k,hk,hp⟩:= Metric.mem_closure_iff.1 (show x.val∈closure (Y:Set Wire) from x.property) ε he
    exact ⟨_,⟨⟨k,hk⟩,rfl⟩,show dist x (V ⟨k,hk⟩) < ε from hp⟩
  let P:= ContinuousLinearMap.extend L V
  have hv : ‖P‖≤c := by
    refine (opNorm_extend_le L (N:=1) hV (fun i=> by rw [NNReal.coe_one,one_mul]; exact le_rfl)).trans ?_
    simpa
  let d(i:ℕ):X:=⟨single i,speck hr i⟩; have hk i: ‖d i‖=1:= points i
  let r:=a/p; have hy:0<r:= div_pos hh h'; have hr':r<1:= (div_lt_one h').mpr hp
  let b i := r^i • P (d i)
  have hc i: ‖b i‖ ≤ r^i*c := by
    unfold b; rw [norm_smul, norm_pow,Real.norm_of_nonneg hy.le]; apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (pow_nonneg hy.le _)
    refine (P.le_opNorm _).trans ?_; rwa [hk,mul_one]
  have hs := (hasSum_geometric_of_norm_lt_one (ξ:=r) (by rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg hy.le]; exact hr')).mul_right c
  refine ⟨ha,b,budget_mono (budget_loosen (f:=_) ⟨(fun i=>mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg hy.le i) h.nonneg),hs.summable,hs.tsum_eq.le⟩ le_rfl) (fun _=>norm_nonneg _) hc,?_⟩
  intro x hx; let i:sun:= ⟨x,hx⟩; let h:=Finsupp.single i (1:ℝ); let y: Y:= (smear p).rangeRestrict h
  have hm : IsClosed (X:Set Wire) := Y.isClosed_topologicalClosure
  letI : CompleteSpace X:= hm.isComplete.completeSpace_coe
  let v(j:ℕ):= (x/p)^j • d j; have hz : Summable v:= by
    apply Summable.of_norm; dsimp only [v]; simp_rw [norm_smul,norm_pow,hk,mul_one]; exact summable_geometric_of_lt_one (norm_nonneg _) (radius hr i)
  have he : P (V y)=f x:=by
    unfold P; rw [ContinuousLinearMap.extend_eq L hV ((show Isometry V from fun _ _=> rfl).isUniformInducing),ht]; simp [trace,h,i] -- L y issue
  have hh : ∑' i,v i=V y:=by
    apply Subtype.ext
    calc _ = _ := ((X.subtypeL.hasSum hz.hasSum).tsum_eq).symm
         _ = _ := Eq.symm (show (V y).val=wire p i from start _ i)
  rw [← he,← hh]; apply (P.hasSum hz.hasSum).congr_fun
  intro i; unfold b v; simp_rw [map_smul, smul_smul,← mul_pow]; rw [show x/a*r=x/p from by unfold r; field_simp]

proof_context.conclusion: `Rebar p f c` (stencil bound) gives `Scout a f ((1-a/p)⁻¹*c)` for 1 ≤ a < p, by extending the linear map `linear_snapshot` to the closure `spans p`, showing the coordinate vectors lie in it (`speck`), and evaluating on one point.

snippet.text:
lemma linear_snapshot (h:Rebar p f c) (hp:1<p) : ∃ L : (smear p).range →L[ℝ] E, ‖L‖≤ c ∧∀ w:Rung,L ((smear p).rangeRestrict w)= trace w f:=by
  let P:=smear p; let F:Rung →ₗ[ℝ] E:= Finsupp.linearCombination ℝ (fun i:sun=> f i.val)
  have hB (w:Rung):‖F w‖≤ c*‖P w‖ := by
    rw [mul_comm]; apply h.beam w; intro i
    have hh:(P w) i=trace w (fun x=>(x/p)^i):=by
      unfold P smear trace; simp_rw [Finsupp.linearCombination_apply,Finsupp.sum,lp.coeFn_sum,Finset.sum_apply,lp.coeFn_smul,Pi.smul_apply,fil hp]
    rw [← hh]; exact lp.norm_apply_le_norm (by simp) _ _
  let g:= P.rangeRestrict
  obtain ⟨b,hb⟩:= LinearMap.exists_rightInverse_of_surjective g (LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr P.surjective_rangeRestrict)
  have hh x: P (b x) = x.val:= congr_arg Subtype.val (DFunLike.congr_fun hb x)
  let L:= F.comp b
  have hk x: ‖L x‖≤ c*‖x‖ := (hB _).trans_eq (congr_arg (fun x'=>c*‖x'‖) (hh x))
  refine ⟨L.mkContinuous c hk, LinearMap.mkContinuous_norm_le _ h.nonneg hk,?_⟩
  intro w; change F (b (g w))=F w; have he:= hB (b (g w)-w); rw [map_sub,map_sub,hh] at he; rw [show (g w).val=P w from rfl, sub_self,norm_zero,mul_zero] at he; exact sub_eq_zero.mp (norm_le_zero_iff.mp he)

proof_context.conclusion: The stencil inequality `Rebar p f c` defines a linear map `L` on the span of the stencil sequences with `‖L‖ ≤ c` and `L w = trace w f`.

lemma speck (n:ℕ) : single n ∈ spans p:=by
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h n ih =>
    suffices h: single n∈ closure (spans p:Set Wire) from by rw [IsClosed.closure_eq (show IsClosed (spans p : Set Wire) from (smear p).range.isClosed_topologicalClosure)] at h; exact h
    apply Metric.mem_closure_iff.mpr
    intro ε he
    let t:= min (ε/2) 1 / 2; have ht:0<t:= half_pos (lt_min (half_pos he) zero_lt_one)
    have h₁:t≤1:= (half_le_self ((lt_min (half_pos he) zero_lt_one).le)).trans (min_le_right ..)
    have h₂:t<ε:= ((half_le_self ((lt_min (half_pos he) zero_lt_one).le)).trans (min_le_left ..)).trans_lt (half_lt_self he)
    let s:sun:= ⟨t,⟨by linarith,h₁⟩⟩; let r:= s.val/p; have hp':= zero_lt_one.trans hp; have hr:0<r:= div_pos ht hp'; have h:=radius hp s
    let w : Wire:= (r^n)⁻¹ • (wire p s-∑ i∈Finset.range n,r^i • single i)
    refine ⟨w,(spans p).smul_mem _ ((spans p).sub_mem (holds hp s) ((spans p).sum_mem fun i hi=> (spans p).smul_mem _ (ih _ (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)))),?_⟩
    rw [dist_eq_norm]; refine lt_of_le_of_lt (b:=t) (lp.norm_le_of_forall_le ht.le fun j=>?_) h₂
    have hp₁: (∑ i∈ Finset.range n,r^i • single i:Wire) j=(if j<n then r^j else 0):=by
      rw [lp.coeFn_sum,Finset.sum_apply]; simp only [lp.coeFn_smul, Pi.smul_apply,smul_eq_mul,single,lp.single_apply,Pi.single_apply]; simp
    unfold w; rw [lp.coeFn_sub,Pi.sub_apply, lp.coeFn_smul, Pi.smul_apply,lp.coeFn_sub,Pi.sub_apply,hp₁]; rw [single,lp.single_apply,fil hp]
    rcases lt_trichotomy j n with hj|hj|hj
    · rw [if_pos hj,Pi.single_eq_of_ne (by omega),show s.val/p=r from rfl]; simp [ht.le]
    · subst n; rw [if_neg (by omega), Pi.single_eq_same,show s.val/p=r from rfl]; simp [hr.ne',ht.le]
    rw [if_neg (by omega), Pi.single_eq_of_ne (by omega), show s.val/p=r from rfl]; obtain ⟨d,hD⟩:= Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le (show n+1≤j from hj); subst j
    rw [sub_zero,smul_eq_mul,pow_add,pow_succ]
    have hx := pow_le_one₀ hr.le ((le_abs_self _).trans (Real.norm_eq_abs _ ▸ h.le)) (n:=d)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, show 0-(r^n)⁻¹*(r^n*r*r^d)= -(r*r^d) from by field_simp; ring,abs_neg,abs_of_nonneg (by positivity : 0≤ r*r^d)]
    exact (mul_le_of_le_one_right hr.le hx).trans (show r≤ t from div_le_self ht.le hp.le)

proof_context.conclusion: Every coordinate vector `single n` lies in the closure `spans p` of the stencil span, by the finite-difference approximation with mesh t → 0.

snippet.text:
lemma sole {P':ℕ→Y}(h:Tip P B)(hv:Tip P' B):P=P':=by
  have ht: Tip (P-P') (0:ℝ→Y):=by
    intro k; have hh:= (h k).sub (hv k); refine hh.congr_left fun x=>?_; simp [Pi.sub_apply, shell, smul_sub,sum_sub_distrib]
  funext j; exact sub_eq_zero.mp (pace ht (n:=j+1) (isBigO_zero ..) j.lt_succ_self)

proof_context.conclusion: Two expansions `Tip P B`, `Tip P' B` of the same function have equal coefficients, so the series is unique.
